ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial covenant interest coverage ratio
ratios.quote: At June 30, 2026, Cat Financial’s covenant interest coverage ratio was 1.54 to 1. This was above the 1.15 to 1 minimum ratio

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial six-month covenant leverage ratio (debt to net worth)
ratios.quote: In addition, at June 30, 2026, Cat Financial’s six-month covenant leverage ratio was 7.96 to 1. This was below the maximum ratio of debt to net worth of 10 to 1

parsed.notes: Both ratios apply to Cat Financial, Caterpillar's consolidated financial-services subsidiary and a borrower under the shared Credit Facility. The leverage ratio is debt to net worth, not debt to EBITDA, so it is classified as 'other'. It is measured as a six-month average of month-end ratios. The Credit Facility also requires Caterpillar to keep a minimum consolidated net worth of $9.000 billion; actual was $19.463 billion at June 30, 2026. That is a dollar threshold rather than a ratio, so it is not listed. There were no borrowings under the Credit Facility at June 30, 2026.
